description: Comprehensive scholarship, welfare board, and institutional merit opportunity database with verified official information & application URLs for Class 12 passed students in Tamil Nadu.

opportunities.title: Rajalakshmi Institutions (REC/RIT) 100% Free Seat (Sabari Foundation)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: TNEA Engineering Cut-off >= 190.00 / 200 in 12th Board examinations for PCM stream.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Free Tuition Fee for all 4 years + 100% Free Hostel & Mess Accommodation OR Free College Bus Transportation.
opportunities.applicationMethod: College Admissions Office / TNEA Counseling Choice Filling

opportunities.title: Rajalakshmi Institutions (REC/RIT) 50% Merit Scholarship (Sabari Foundation)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: TNEA Cut-off between 180.00 and 189.50 / 200 in 12th Board examinations.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 50% Tuition Fee waiver + 50% concession on Hostel/Mess charges or College Bus charges for 4 years.

opportunities.title: SSN College of Engineering 100% Free Education & Rural Topper Scholarship
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Top 25 State Board rankers or TNEA Cut-off >= 195.00 / 200. Dedicated 25 free seats for Rural Government School toppers in Tamil Nadu.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Free Tuition Fee + Free Shared Hostel Accommodation + Free Mess Food + Annual Book Allowance.

opportunities.title: Sri Sairam Institutions 100% Free Seat (Leo Muthu Foundation)
opportunities.providerName: Sapthagiri Educational Trust / Leo Muthu Foundation
opportunities.institutionName: Sri Sairam Engineering College / Sairam Institute of Tech
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 12th Standard TNEA Cut-Off >= 190.00 / 200.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver + 100% Free Hostel/Mess or College Bus transport charges.

opportunities.title: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (BIT) 100% Full Scholarship
opportunities.institutionName: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology, Sathyamangalam
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: TNEA Cut-Off >= 190.00 / 200 in 12th Board examinations.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver + 100% Free Hostel Accommodation and Mess Food for 4 years.

opportunities.title: KPR Institute of Engineering 100% Free Higher Education Scheme
opportunities.institutionName: KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology, Coimbatore
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 12th Standard TNEA Cut-Off >= 190.00 / 200.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver + 100% Free Hostel & Food for all 4 years. (Cut-off 180-189 gets 50% waiver).

opportunities.title: Sri Krishna Institutions (SKCET / SKCT) VLB Trust Merit Waiver
opportunities.institutionName: Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 12th Cut-Off >= 190.00 / 200 (100% waiver) | Cut-off 185-189.5 (50% waiver).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% or 50% Academic Tuition Fee Waivers.

opportunities.title: Saveetha Engineering College 100% Free Tuition Scheme
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Cut-Off >= 190.00 / 200 or PCM aggregate >= 95%.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition fee waiver for 4 years (Cut-off 180-189 receives 50% waiver).

opportunities.title: Vel Tech Mahatma Gandhi National Merit Scholarship
opportunities.providerName: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: PCM Board Percentage >= 95% (100% fee waiver), 90-94.9% (75% waiver), 80-89.9% (50% waiver).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Up to 100% Tuition and Hostel fee waivers.

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board Educational Grant
opportunities.providerName: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board (TNCWWB)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Either parent must be a registered active member of TN Construction Workers Welfare Board. Enrolled in regular UG Arts/Science, Engg, Medical, Agri, or Law.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Arts/Science: ₹1,500 to ₹3,000/yr (Hostel extra). Professional degrees: ₹4,000 to ₹6,000/yr (Hostel up to ₹12,000/yr).

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu Unorganized Workers Welfare Board Educational Assistance
opportunities.providerName: Tamil Nadu Manual / Unorganized Workers Welfare Boards
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Children of registered members across 18 unorganized welfare boards (Auto drivers, tailoring, manual labour, handloom, etc.).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Fixed annual educational assistance and hostel grants credited directly into student bank account.

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu Labour Welfare Board Scholarship (Organized Sector)
opportunities.providerName: Department of Labour Welfare & Skill Development, TN
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Children of employees in registered factories/IT/shops contributing to TN Labour Welfare Fund. Monthly basic salary <= ₹25,000.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Engineering/Medical: ₹12,000 to ₹50,000/yr; Arts/Science: ₹3,000 to ₹10,000/yr + Book Allowance and hostel reimbursement.
opportunities.applicationMethod: Form submission to TNLWB Chennai / Online

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu 7.5% Government School Quota 100% Free Higher Education Scheme
opportunities.providerName: Department of Higher Education, Govt of Tamil Nadu
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Students who studied Classes 6 to 12 continuously in Tamil Nadu Government Schools admitted via Counseling (TNEA, NEET, TNAU, TANUVAS, TNDALU).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Full Free Education: Complete Tuition Fees, Hostel Accommodation, Food, Special Fees, and University Exam Fees paid by Govt of Tamil Nadu.

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession (முதல் தலைமுறை பட்டதாரி)
opportunities.providerName: Department of Higher Education, Govt of Tamil Nadu
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Student must be the first graduate in the entire family and admitted via Tamil Nadu Government Single Window Counseling. No income ceiling.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Direct tuition fee concession of ₹25,000/year (Non-Accredited) to ₹27,500/year (Accredited courses).
opportunities.applicationMethod: First Graduate Certificate via e-Sevai presented during Counseling

opportunities.title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar 'Pudhumai Penn' Higher Education Scheme (Girls)
opportunities.providerName: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, TN
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools pursuing regular UG Degree, Diploma, or ITI.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000/year) directly transferred to the student's bank account until degree completion.

opportunities.title: Tamil Pudhalvan Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Boys)
opportunities.providerName: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, TN
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Male students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Govt / Govt-Aided (Tamil Medium) Schools enrolled in regular UG/Diploma.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000/year) directly credited to the student's bank account.

opportunities.title: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Free Higher Education for SC / ST / SCA / SCC
opportunities.providerName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: SC, ST, SCA, and SCC students with annual family income under ₹2,50,000.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver in Govt & Self-Financing colleges + Monthly Maintenance Allowance.

opportunities.title: Agaram Foundation 'Vidhai' 100% Free Higher Education Sponsorship
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Economically disadvantaged rural students, orphans, single-parent children from Tamil Nadu with exceptional 12th board marks.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Free Higher Education: College Tuition Fees + Free Hostel + Free Food + Soft Skills Coaching + Placement Mentorship.
opportunities.applicationMethod: Written Application Form -> Home Visit Verification -> Interview

opportunities.title: Maatram Foundation 100% Free Higher Education Program
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Deserving students from economically deprived families (daily-wage earners, single mothers, first-generation graduates).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Free Higher Education across top partner colleges: Zero Tuition, Zero Hostel, Zero Food, Zero Bus Fees.
opportunities.applicationMethod: Online Application -> Telephonic Round -> Personal Interview

opportunities.title: Team Everest NGO 'I am the Future' Full Fee Scholarship
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Parentless (orphan), single-parent, or differently-abled parent students from Tamil Nadu. Min 70% in 12th.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% College Tuition Fees covered for 3-year or 4-year degree + 100 hours of English & Employability Skills coaching.

opportunities.title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP)
opportunities.providerName: Ministry of Education, Government of India
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Scored above 80th percentile in 12th Board Examinations; Family income under ₹4,50,000/year.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹12,000/year for first 3 years of UG; ₹20,000/year for 4th and 5th years (Engineering / Integrated PG).

opportunities.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
opportunities.providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Up to 2 girl children per family admitted to 1st year of AICTE-approved Degree or Diploma institution; Family income < ₹8,00,000/year.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹50,000 per year for all 4 years of study towards tuition fees, laptop, and academic expenses.

opportunities.title: Siemens Scholarship Program (100% Full Tuition + Laptop + Allowance)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 1st-year students of Government Engineering Colleges in Mech, EEE, ECE, CS, IT; 12th PCM >= 60%; Income < ₹2,50,000/year.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fees Paid + Annual Book Allowance + Free Laptop + Siemens Industrial Internships.

opportunities.title: Kotak Kanya Scholarship (Girls in Professional Degrees)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Meritorious girl students with >= 85% in 12th admitted to 1st year Engineering, MBBS, Architecture, or Integrated Law; Income < ₹6,00,000.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹1,50,000 per year towards tuition fees, hostel, laptop, and academic expenses until graduation.

opportunities.title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 1st-year full-time UG students with >= 60% in 12th; Family annual income < ₹15,00,000 (preference < ₹2.5 Lakhs).
opportunities.benefitsDescription: Up to ₹2,00,000 total financial grant disbursed across the degree program.

opportunities.title: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Students pursuing general UG or professional courses; 12th marks >= 55%; Family income < ₹2,50,000/year.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹30,000 to ₹75,000 per year regular annual disbursement.

opportunities.title: Santoor Women's Scholarship (Wipro Consumer Care)
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: Girl students from Tamil Nadu who completed 10th & 12th in Govt/Govt-Aided schools enrolled in regular 3/4-year UG courses.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: ₹24,000 per year until completion of graduation.

opportunities.title: Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation Scholarship
opportunities.eligibilitySummary: 1st-year students admitted on merit in MBBS, Engineering, Agriculture, Nursing, or MBA; Income < ₹3,00,000.
opportunities.benefitsDescription: 100% Tuition Fee Refund + University and examination fee coverage.
